nodes.label: Vought Productions Screensaver
nodes.description: Screensaver image themed around 'Vought Productions', a fictional media company from the TV show 'The Boys'. Displays a dark, gritty design with the Vought logo (a stylized V), the text 'PRODUCTION PAUSED' in bold industrial typography with red and white coloring, and a corporate message: 'Vought Productions is temporarily pausing all current film and television projects. We remain committed to creating powerful, inspiring content that shapes culture. Thank you for your understanding.' Tagline at bottom reads 'STRENGTH. TRUTH. ENTERTAINMENT.' The aesthetic is intentionally ominous and satirical, mimicking a real corporate pause announcement.

nodes.label: Production Paused State (Vought)
nodes.description: Visual representation of a 'paused' or idle screensaver state themed as Vought Productions pausing production. In the app context, this screensaver likely appears when the app is idle or loading, using the Vought Productions brand as a thematic/satirical overlay for a better-schoology school tool.

nodes.label: The Boys (TV Show) Theme Reference
nodes.description: The Vought International/Vought Productions brand is from the Amazon Prime Video series 'The Boys', a satirical superhero show. This screensaver uses that fictional corporate aesthetic. Indicates the app may use pop culture or satirical screensaver themes.

nodes.label: Screensaver Asset (App Idle State)
nodes.description: One of potentially multiple screensaver images stored in the public/ directory for the better-schoology app. Used as a decorative or idle-state background screen, likely cycling through various pop culture themed screensavers.
